title: Karan Johar Unfollowed SRK, Alia Bhatt, and Basically All of Bollywood. He Says It's a Digital Detox, Not a Breakup.
excerpt: The filmmaker's Instagram following list dropped to 78 accounts. Priyanka Chopra survived the purge. The internet lost its mind anyway.
body:
Karan Johar unfollowed Shah Rukh Khan on Instagram. And Alia Bhatt. And Kareena Kapoor Khan. And Varun Dhawan, Sidharth Malhotra, Manish Malhotra, Ananya Panday, Kartik Aaryan, Malaika Arora, and basically everyone he's ever publicly called a friend.

The filmmaker's following list dropped to just 78 accounts, and the Indian internet did what it does best — spiraled into speculation about feuds, fallouts, and secret grudges.

## What Actually Happened

Karan Johar took to his Instagram Stories to clarify — in all caps, because of course — that this was nothing more than a personal decision to spend less time on the platform.

"It's a DIGITAL DETOX!!!! Am unfollowing everyone to reduce my time and energy spent on the gram!!!" he wrote. "This can't be national news for gods sake...please clickbait something else! This is irrelevant!"

Sources close to the filmmaker confirmed to Filmfare that the unfollowing was a planned social media strategy, with no connection to any particular person or professional relationship.

## The Priyanka Chopra Detail

What made the internet lose its collective mind even further was a small but noticeable detail: Priyanka Chopra Jonas remained on Karan's following list. Given the well-documented history between the two — Priyanka once memorably called out Karan on his own talk show — her continued presence on his list while SRK and Alia were removed fueled a fresh round of theories.

The more likely explanation, as is usually the case with these things, is considerably less dramatic. A social media cleanup rarely unfolds in a single sitting, and the accounts that remain are often the ones that simply haven't been reached yet.

## Why This Is a Story At All

Karan Johar unfollowing people on Instagram shouldn't be national news. He said so himself. But the fact that it became one — trending on X, spawning Reddit threads, generating dozens of news articles — says something about the peculiar relationship between Bollywood celebrities and their digital audiences.

For NRIs scrolling through social media from time zones away, Bollywood Instagram accounts are often the primary connection to the industry. Who follows whom, who likes whose posts, who shows up at whose party — these digital signals have become a parallel narrative track to the films themselves. When someone like Karan Johar, who has practically built his brand around being connected to everyone, suddenly disconnects, it reads like a seismic event even when it's just a guy clearing his feed.

## The Chand Mera Dil Context

The timing is worth noting. Karan recently produced *Chand Mera Dil*, starring Ananya Panday and Lakshya, which received a mixed response at the box office. Whether the digital detox is a genuine desire to step back or a strategic reset ahead of whatever comes next remains to be seen.

Either way, Karan Johar not following Shah Rukh Khan on Instagram is not, in fact, the end of an era. It's just 2026.
author: Diaspora Desk
